title: Duplicate card payment
content: A card transaction appears more than once. Check pending versus settled entries and raise a duplicate-charge dispute when required.

title: Unexpected fee or incorrect charge
content: Review fees, merchant descriptors and billed amounts. Unexplained or incorrect charges require a billing investigation.

title: Refund pending
content: Refunds can take several business days after release. Verify the reference and expected settlement window.

title: Refund amount incorrect
content: Compare the original transaction, refund reference and merchant confirmation when a refund amount is wrong.

title: Password and account lock
content: Use the recovery flow for forgotten passwords. Locked accounts can require identity verification.

title: OTP or authentication problem
content: For missing or invalid OTP codes, verify the registered contact method, device time and authenticator setup.

title: Application crash or freeze
content: Capture app version, device details and reproduction steps for crashes or freezes; then retry after cache and update checks.

title: Network, sync or upload error
content: For timeout, sync or upload failures, verify connectivity, service status and file constraints before escalation.

title: Update profile details
content: Update email, phone, address and profile preferences after identity verification.

title: Close or manage account
content: Account closure and preference changes require confirmation and may have retention or balance prerequisites.

title: Order delayed or missing
content: Track the shipment using the order ID. Delayed or missing deliveries may require a carrier investigation.

title: Wrong or damaged delivery
content: Capture the order ID, item details and evidence before replacement or return for wrong or damaged items.
